'''Gašper Tkačik''' (born 1979) is a Slovenian [[theoretical physics|theoretical physicist]] and [[computational neuroscience|computational neuroscientist]].

==Life and work==
After completing his [[International Baccalaureate]] from [[Bežigrad Grammar School|Bežigrad high school]] in Ljubljana, he enrolled in the department of mathematics and physics at the [[University of Ljubljana]], where he received a [[Bachelor of Science]] degree in physics in 2001.<ref name="Delo_about_Tkačik">{{Cite web |title=V Sloveniji doktorandom ne zaupajo dovolj |url=http://www.delo.si/clanek/131631 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304052024/http://www.delo.si/clanek/131631 |archive-date=2016-03-04 |access-date=2025-07-13 |website=www.delo.si |url-status=live }}</ref> He continued his studies at [[Princeton University]] with [[William Bialek]] and [[Curtis Callan]] where he received a [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in physics. Later he was a [[postdoc]] at the [[University of Pennsylvania]] until he was employed at the [[Institute of Science and Technology Austria]].<ref name="Delo_about_Tkačik"/>
